# ChunkEmpty

> **Kind:** component · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/logic/terrain/`](../folders/src-logic-terrain.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/terrain/chunk.h`](../../../src/logic/terrain/chunk.h)

## Summary

Marks a chunk whose samples are all on the same side of the surface, with their mean.

## Description

Emplaced by ChunkGeneratorSys::collect instead of ChunkVolume when no surface crosses the chunk (all samples > 0 or all <= 0). TerrainColliders treats a cell inside such a chunk as having no surface (no collider), whatever the sign; nothing outside src/logic reads `mean`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mean` | `float` | uninitialized (set from the constructor argument) | mean density of the chunk's samples |
